/********************************************************************/
/*                     Interface States                             */
/********************************************************************/
#define IFSDOWN        0x01  /* Interface down            */
#define IFSBACKUP      0x02  /* Interface backup          */
#define IFSLOOPED      0x04  /* Looped back               */
#define IFSWAIT        0x08  /* Waiting for DR selection  */
#define IFSPP          0x10  /* Point-to-point or virtual */
#define IFSOTHER       0x20  /* Neither DR or Backup      */
#define IFSBDR         0x40  /* Backup Designated Router  */
#define IFSDR          0x80  /* Designated Router         */

/********************************************************************/
/*                     Interface Types                              */
/********************************************************************/
#define BCST        1           /* Broadcast interface          */
#define PP          2           /* Point-to-point interface     */
#define MA          3           /* Multi-access, non-broadcast  */
#define VL          4           /* Virtual link                 */

/*******************************************************************/
/*                     Neighbor States                             */
/*******************************************************************/
#define DOWN        0x01            /* Neighbor is unreachable  */
#define ATTEMPT     0x02            /* Attempting to contact
                                           neighbor             */
#define INIT        0x04            /* Have seen its hellos     */
#define WA2Y        0x08            /* And it has seen ours     */
#define EXSTART     0x10            /* Master/slave negotiation */
#define EXCHANGE    0x20            /* Database exchange        */
#define LOADING     0x40            /* requesting newer pieces  */
#define FULL        0x80            /* Fully adjacent           */

/*******************************************************************/
/*                     Virtual Link States                         */
/*******************************************************************/
#define VTDOWN          0x01  /* Virtual Link down                 */
#define VTPP            0x10  /* Virtual Link up                   */

/*******************************************************************/
/*                    IPv4 Link State Advertisement                */
/*******************************************************************/
#define LSTRL          1             /* Router links advertisement  */
#define LSTNL          2             /* Network links advertisement */
#define LSTSL          3             /* Summary link advertisement  */
#define LSTSRL         4             /* Summary to ASBR             */
#define LSTASL         5             /* AS external link            */

/*******************************************************************/
/*                    IPv6 Link State Advertisement                */
/*******************************************************************/
#define LST6RL          0x2001          /* Router LSA                */
#define LST6NL          0x2002          /* Network LSA               */
#define INTERPL         0x2003          /* Inter-Area Prefix LSA     */
#define INTERRL         0x2004          /* Inter-Area Router LSA     */
#define LST6ASL         0x4005          /* AS external LSA           */
#define LST6LL          0x0008          /* Link LSA                  */
#define INTRAPL         0x2009          /* Intra-Area Prefix LSA     */

 /* Prototype for calling Retrieve OSPF State Information API      */

 /******************************************************************/
 /* Type Definition for the IPv4 OSPF Area List Entry - it contains*/
 /* the fields for OSPF Area Information.                          */
 /****                                                          ****/
 /******************************************************************/

 typedef _Packed struct Qtoo_IPv4_OSPF_Area_Entry
 {
       unsigned char  AreaID [15];
       unsigned char  Reserved [1];
       unsigned long  SPF_Runs;
       unsigned long  Area_BR_Count;
       unsigned long  Total_Number_of_LSA_Area;
 } Qtoo_IPv4_OSPF_Area_Entry_t;

/******************************************************************/
/* Type Definition for the IPv6 OSPF Area List Entry - it contains*/
/* the fields for OSPF Area Information.                          */
/****                                                          ****/
/******************************************************************/

 typedef _Packed struct Qtoo_IPv6_OSPF_Area_Entry
 {
       unsigned char  AreaID [15];
       unsigned char  Reserved [1];
       unsigned long  SPF_Runs;
       unsigned long  Area_BR_Count;
       unsigned long  Total_Number_of_LSA_Area;
 } Qtoo_IPv6_OSPF_Area_Entry_t;



 /******************************************************************/
 /* Type Definition for the IPv4 OSPF Interface Entry              */
 /******************************************************************/

 typedef _Packed struct Qtoo_IPv4_OSPF_Ifc_Entry
    {
       char IP_Address[15];
       char AreaID[15];
       unsigned char  Reserved1 [2];
       unsigned long  Interface_Type;
       unsigned long  Designated_Router_Pri;
       unsigned long  Transmission_Dly;
       unsigned long  Retransmission_Dly;
       unsigned long  Hello_Interval;
       unsigned long  Inactive_Router_Interval;
       unsigned long  Poll_Interval;
       unsigned long  Interface_State;
       unsigned long  Designated_Router[15];
       unsigned long  Backup_Designated_Router[15];
       unsigned char  Reserved2 [2];
       unsigned long  Cost;
       char PPP_Connection_Profile[10];
       unsigned char  Reserved3[2];
    } Qtoo_IPv4_OSPF_Ifc_Entry_t;

/******************************************************************/
/* Type Definition for the IPv6 OSPF Interface Entry              */
/******************************************************************/

 typedef _Packed struct Qtoo_IPv6_OSPF_Ifc_Entry
    {
       unsigned char IPv6_Address[45];
       unsigned char AreaID[15];
       unsigned long Interface_Type;
       unsigned long Designated_Router_Pri;
       unsigned long Transmission_Dly;
       unsigned long Retransmission_Dly;
       unsigned long Hello_Interval;
       unsigned long Inactive_Router_Interval;
       unsigned long Poll_Interval;
       unsigned long Interface_State;
       unsigned char Designated_Router[45];
       unsigned char Backup_Designated_Router[45];
       unsigned char Reserved4[2];
       unsigned long Cost;
    } Qtoo_IPv6_OSPF_Ifc_Entry_t;


/******************************************************************/
/* Type Definition for the IPv4 OSPF Neighbor Entry               */
/******************************************************************/

 typedef _Packed struct Qtoo_IPv4_OSPF_Neighbor_Entry
    {
       unsigned char Ifc_IP_address     [15];
       unsigned char Neighbor_IP_Address[15];
       unsigned char RouterID[15];
       unsigned char  Reserved5 [3];
       unsigned long  Neighbor_Options;
       unsigned long  Neighbor_Priority;
       unsigned long  Neighbor_State;
       unsigned long  Neighbor_Events;
    } Qtoo_IPv4_OSPF_Neighbor_Entry_t;

 /******************************************************************/
 /* Type Definition for the SPFI0100 format - General OSPF Info    */
 /****                                                          ****/
 /* NOTE: The following type definition only defines the fixed     */
 /*       portion of the format.  Any varying length field will    */
 /*       have to be defined by the user.                          */
 /******************************************************************/

 typedef _Packed struct Qtoo_SPFI0100
    {
       unsigned long  Bytes_Returned;
       unsigned long  Bytes_Available;
       unsigned char  RouterID[15];
       unsigned char  Reserved13 [1];
       unsigned long  Attached_Areas;
       unsigned long  Dijkstra_Runs;
       unsigned long  OSPFPkt_Received;
       unsigned long  LSA_Allocated;
       unsigned long  Offset_To_IPv4_Area_Lst;
       unsigned long  Number_Of_IPv4_Area_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Length_Of_IPv4_Area_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Offset_To_IPv6_Area_Lst;
       unsigned long  Number_Of_IPv6_Area_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Length_Of_IPv6_Area_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Offset_To_IPv4_Ifc_Lst;
       unsigned long  Number_Of_IPv4_Ifc_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Length_To_IPv4_Ifc_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Offset_To_IPv6_Ifc_Lst;
       unsigned long  Number_Of_IPv6_Ifc_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Length_To_IPv6_Ifc_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Offset_To_IPv4_Neigh_Lst;
       unsigned long  Number_Of_IPv4_Neigh_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Length_To_IPv4_Neigh_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Offset_To_IPv6_Neigh_Lst;
       unsigned long  Number_Of_IPv6_Neigh_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Length_To_IPv6_Neigh_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Offset_To_IPv4_Vtl_Lst;
       unsigned long  Number_Of_IPv4_Vtl_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Length_to_IPv4_Vtl_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Offset_To_IPv6_Vtl_Lst;
       unsigned long  Number_Of_IPv6_Vtl_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Length_to_IPv6_Vtl_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Offset_to_IPv4_LSA_Lst;
       unsigned long  Number_Of_IPv4_LSA_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Length_to_IPv4_LSA_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Offset_to_IPv6_LSA_Lst;
       unsigned long  Number_Of_IPv6_LSA_Lst_Ent;
       unsigned long  Length_to_IPv6_LSA_Lst_Ent;
/*Qtoo_IPv4_OSPF_Area_Entry_t Qtoo_IPv4_OSPF_Area_Entry[];*/
/*Qtoo_IPv6_OSPF_Area_Entry_t Qtoo_IPv6_OSPF_Area_Entry[];*/

/*Qtoo_IPv4_OSPF_Vtl_Link_Entry_t Qtoo_IPv4_OSPF_Vtl_Link_Entry[];*/
